notes.title: MAC OS support has been added!
notes.content:
Major updates:
Good news for Apple users!
A new version has been released to support MAC OS play.

Fixed setting function error:
The useless function buttons in the Option page have been removed and replaced with more convenient functions.
Installed to view updates in the library. If updates are not pushed automatically, manually detect the updates.

tags.feature: A new version has been released to support MAC OS play.

tags.bug: The useless function buttons in the Option page have been removed and replaced with more convenient functions.

notes.title: Update report - bug fixed
notes.content:
At present, the collected typographical / person name display bugs have been fixed. There may be a few errors, please continue to report to us!

Only a few lines of the history of the backlog interface have been fixed. You can see a lot of historical information!

If there is no automatic update, please manually check the update before the game starts.


We use Utage3 to develop the game for the first time. There are inevitably omissions. 
We welcome feedback. We will fix it as soon as we receive it!
